g.text: Both hops must be the same origin. Spring keeps
the pending authorization request in a session
cookie; start on one origin and return to another
and the callback dies on a state mismatch. That is
why production points straight at the backend and
exchange the code, load the profile

Every refusal is caught here. Letting one
propagate renders the backend's error page,
on the backend's domain, to somebody who
clicked a button on the frontend — it reads
as a crash with no way back.
